title: The Inventory of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Paloma Okafor
blurb: Astrid Whitlock, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
